scope: preparação candidate-bound para retenção segura de refs/objetos Git no repositório local, preservando rollback e sem executar limpeza destrutiva

criteria.description: A superfície Git, refs protegidos, estado do worktree, armazenamento e objetos candidatos foram inventariados com o candidate remoto separado do checkout local.
criteria.limitations: A fotografia é local; ownership e prazo de retenção para refs não protegidos ainda não foram fornecidos.

criteria.description: Invariantes de rollback, alcance de refs, limite de blob, dry-run, stop conditions e comportamento fail-closed foram definidos antes de qualquer prune/gc/reflog expiration.
criteria.limitations: A versão instalada do Git não oferece gc/repack dry-run; esses comandos foram rejeitados por opção desconhecida e não foram substituídos por execução destrutiva.

criteria.description: A fatia segura está preparada e a próxima rota exige autoridade humana explícita para refs/objetos exatos, retenção aprovada e owner de rollback.
criteria.limitations: Nenhuma autoridade para remoção, expiração de reflog, prune, gc ou repack foi inferida da autorização anterior de REM-002.

gaps: No named retention owner, approved retention period or exact deletion set was supplied.
The shared checkout remains dirty on the pre-rewrite local tip and cannot be cleaned or moved by this task.
No destructive cleanup, reflog expiration, prune, gc, repack or ref deletion was executed.

conditions.description: Obtain explicit human authority naming the exact refs/objects, approved retention period, rollback owner and allowed Git operation before any deletion or expiration.
conditions.impact: Preparation may close, but the destructive execution remains blocked and must not be inferred from REM-002 authority.
conditions.verification_method: Confirmed authority record bound to a superseding REM-044 gate with exact scope and evidence reference.

conditions.description: Immediately before any approved cleanup, create and verify a fresh all-refs bundle and recovery clone, then revalidate the exact refs and object inventory.
conditions.impact: No cleanup command may start if the fresh freeze or recovery check fails.
conditions.owner: Codex acting under the approved repository owner
conditions.verification_method: Bundle verify, SHA-256 manifest, fresh clone, ref/object inventory and post-action recovery comparison.

authority.actor: named repository/retention authority not yet supplied
authority.scope: REM-044 ref/object expiration and Git garbage-collection/pruning for the local repository; exact refs, objects, retention period and rollback owner must be approved.
authority.decision: Await explicit CONFIRMED authority before any destructive retention action.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate immediately after a new authority decision, source/control mutation, remote ref change or backup mutation.

revalidation_triggers: A ref, tag, remote, worktree or backup changes.
A confirmed authority record names a different retention set or period.
Any cleanup command fails, lacks a trustworthy dry-run or changes the protected rollback inventory.
